velvet.about: Velvet: 12 Avelia Horizon trains ordered, services from 2028 between Paris and Angers, Rennes, Nantes and Bordeaux, 10 million more seats a year; the operator says 15% of would-be rail passengers go by car, coach or air for want of trains
